s1.syndrome_frame: Lesion on the glans penis with atypical clear cell tumor and lymphovascular invasion
salient_findings: 2 × 2 cm irregular, friable mass on the glans
Nearly complete epidermal ulceration with replacement by an in-situ and diffusely infiltrative atypical clear cell tumor
key_facts: 78-year-old man
History of diabetes mellitus
History of hypertension
History of moderately differentiated prostatic adenocarcinoma without evidence of metastasis
History of nodular basal cell carcinoma
Lesion on the glans penis
Deep shave biopsy showed nearly complete epidermal ulceration
Tumor consisted of large irregular nests and lobules of clear cells
Abundant multivacuolated cytoplasm, nuclear indentations, and vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei
Lymphovascular invasion present
